fields.description: Program Description The duration of study is generally 1 year. You can join the Chinese Hanyu Shuiping Kaoshi (HSK for short) and get the Chinese Hanyu Shuiping Kaoshi certificate. Through long-term and short-term Chinese language training, you can improve your Chinese application ability in different degrees, deepen your understanding of Chinese language, culture and current situation, and become a high-quality applied talent who can meet the needs of the international community and Chinese proficiency. Main Courses: Chinese Comprehensive Course, Chinese Speaking, Chinese Listening, Chinese Reading and Writing, Chinese traditional culture experience activities (Chinese calligraphy and painting, carving, traditional festivals, etc.). Note: In September 2025, SPPC will move to the new campus. At that time, all students enrolling will be required to live in the on-campus dormitories.

fields.materials: Application Materials " * " means necessary documents that you must provide in your application. If you want to book our translation service , please pay and book it at least 2 weeks before the application deadline for submission of all documents; If you want to book our guardian service , you need to pay and book it 2 months before the application deadline, just in case your application fails because of failed to submit application documents on time. * 1. Color ID photo Photo format: Color standard passport photo, with a file size not exceeding 200kb, and supporting image formats of *.jpg,*.jpeg. Pixel dimensions should be larger than 295*413. The photo name must match the passport number. The naming rule for the photo is: passport number.jpg/jpeg. * 2. Passport homepage If the applicant is currently living in China, a scanned copy of the visa page and residence permit are also required. * 3. Certificate of no criminal record (within 3 months) * 4. Certificate/diploma of highest education Graduation certificate in languages other than Chinese or English should be translated into Chinese or English and be certified by notarization. * 5. Academic transcript of highest education Academic transcript in languages other than Chinese or English should be translated into Chinese or English and be certified by notarization. * 6. Financial Support Guarantee Statement for International Students Photocopy of the financial support statement with signature You can download a template or sample from here . * 7. Uploading Short Video Include brief introduction, and study plan at SPPC, etc, Chinese or English. * 8. Foreigner Physical Examination Form(within 6 months) You can download a template or sample from here . Tips: For applicants who are in China: If you are an employee, you still need to provide employment separation certificate and your current residence permit. If you are a student, you need to provide transfer certificate, leaving certificate, certificate of attendance rate issued by previous school and your current residence permit.
fields.requirements: Entry Requirements 1. Be non-Chinese citizens with a vaild ordinary-type passport, and in good health both mentally and physically. No criminal record. 2. Applicants are generally between 18 and 55 years old (Before June 30 of the admission year). Guardian's Letter of Guarantee is required for applicants under 18 years old. 3. Applicants should have a high school diploma or an equivalent qualification. 4. Zero-based; According to the results of the Chinese proficiency test, students are graded and divided into classes.
